projects.name: Aurora Gardens
projects.description: A green residential community with 60% open space, walkable boulevards and a boutique clubhouse in the heart of East Cairo.

projects.name: Verdant Park

projects.name: Azure Bay
projects.description: A lagoon-front resort community with a private beach, beach club and serviced chalets.

projects.name: Nile Crest Tower

projects.name: The Address

projects.name: Swan Lake
